questions.question: Why is driving at night more dangerous than driving during the day?

options.text: You cannot see as far ahead at night.
The road is always more slippery at night.
Your reaction time is slower at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far ahead at night.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead because of reduced visibility and glare from oncoming headlights. Always use your headlights and drive carefully in the dark.

questions.question: When should you adjust your rearview and side mirrors?

options.text: Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.explanation: Always adjust your mirrors before you drive. You should also adjust your seat, fasten your safety belt, and secure items in your vehicle before moving. Never adjust mirrors while your vehicle is moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk. Watch carefully for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: If a child is riding a bicycle near your vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Expect the child to be in total control of the bicycle.

questions.explanation: Children on bicycles can be unpredictable and may suddenly change direction. Young riders are small and easy to miss. Always be prepared for sudden movements.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flag person is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and allow workers or vehicles to cross.

questions.question: Which of the following is unlawful?

options.text: Pass another vehicle in any marked no passing zone.
Pass another vehicle over a railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to pass in no passing zones, at street crossings, at railroad crossings, where you cannot see far enough ahead, or in work zones. You also cannot pass when the vehicle ahead has stopped for a pedestrian.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Can be hidden in the truck's blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
Have enough space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between their vehicle and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be hidden in the truck's blind spots or are too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are areas where cars disappear into the truck's blind spots. They are also areas where cars are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is unsafe and illegal to make a right turn here.

questions.question: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means that vehicles:

options.text: Next to the broken line may pass.
Next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you may pass.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Pump the brake pedal several times quickly.
Press the brake pedal down as hard as you can.

questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Release the gas pedal and do not brake. Let the car slow down on its own. Use the brakes gently only if needed. Pull over when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: In which of the following situations should your wheels not be pointed straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to turn left at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or sloped driveway.
When parked on the side of a level road with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloped driveway.
questions.explanation: While waiting to turn left, keep your wheels straight. This prevents you from sliding into oncoming traffic if hit from behind. On a hill or slope, turn your wheels so the car will not roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you of dangers ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near work zones.

questions.question: When entering a roundabout, you should slow down and:

options.text: Yield to any crossing pedestrians and bicyclists.
Yield to any car already in the roundabout.

questions.explanation: When entering a roundabout, you must yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Stop to rest or change drivers if you become tired. Tiredness makes you less alert and slows your reaction time, which is dangerous.

questions.question: When double solid yellow lines separate lanes of traffic:

options.text: Passing is permitted from the left.
Passing is permitted from the right.
Passing is not permitted from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not permitted from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines show traffic moving in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean you cannot pass from either direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of hazards in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When driving on the highway, looking far ahead helps you to:

options.text: Reduce the need for last-minute braking or turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce the need for last-minute braking or turning.
questions.explanation: Watch the road far ahead to avoid last-minute braking or turning. This helps you drive safely, save fuel, and keep traffic moving smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you proceed.

questions.question: Your car may hydroplane at speeds as low as:
questions.explanation: At speeds above 35 mph, most tires cannot channel water away from the road. Your tires may lose contact with the road and ride over the water like water skis.
